seoTitle: How to Convert a Canva Presentation to Video
metaDescription: Turn a static Canva slide deck into an MP4 video with custom slide durations, transitions, voiceover, and a downloadable export.
intro: A static slideshow can become a fully automated video with just a few adjustments inside Canva's presentation controls. This guide walks through setting slide durations, adding transitions, recording a voiceover, and exporting the finished piece as an MP4 file, turning your pitch deck into something viewers can watch on their own.

steps.heading: Open the video timeline controls
steps.body: In your slide deck project, expand the standard editor panel into the multi-media video timeline.

steps.heading: Set individual slide durations
steps.body: Adjust the duration slider for each page to match your intended speaking pace.

steps.heading: Add page transitions
steps.body: Apply automatic animations and matching slide-to-slide transitions for a smoother viewing experience.

steps.heading: Record or import audio
steps.body: Import background music or use the built-in microphone to record a live voiceover directly onto your slides.

steps.heading: Balance audio levels
steps.body: Adjust the track sound levels so background music doesn't overpower your narration.

steps.heading: Export as MP4
steps.body: Head to the download panel and select the MP4 video format to save your finished presentation as a video file.

faq.question: Can I record a voiceover directly inside Canva?
faq.answer: Yes, Canva includes a built-in microphone recording feature so you can narrate your slides without separate recording software.

faq.question: Will each slide play for the same amount of time?
faq.answer: No, you can set custom duration sliders for each individual slide to match your speaking pace or content.

faq.question: What file format does the exported video use?
faq.answer: The finished presentation exports as an MP4 video file, which is compatible with most video players and platforms.

faq.question: Can I add background music along with my voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes, you can import background audio and adjust its volume alongside a recorded voiceover for a balanced final mix.
